Subject: Markov chains | ID: 38011

Statement

The rational spectral sequence T on a Kahler manifold X satisfies the maximum principle for the supremum over the domain.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through algebraic approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
